context_requirements: Expression of CCKAR and/or CCKBR on the tumor cell surface
Tumor lineage with autocrine/paracrine CCK signaling (melanoma, pancreatic, gastrointestinal)
Intact apoptotic machinery (caspase-3, BAX) for the cytotoxic component
Prolonged exposure (>=24 h) for transcriptional consequences
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation markers (CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, PCNA) at 24 h in any line
No induction of apoptosis markers (BAX, CASP3, PMAIP1) at 24 h
No differential response between CCKAR/CCKBR-expressing and non-expressing lines
Transcriptional profile indistinguishable from vehicle at both 6 h and 24 h across all nine lines

evidence.supports: CCK receptor antagonists decrease melanoma cell viability by suppressing cell division and inducing BAX/p53-dependent apoptosis
CCK receptor antagonist MK-329 is directly cytotoxic to human pancreatic cancer cells and synergizes with cisplatin
Long-term CCK blockade increases G0/G1 cells and decreases G2/M cells, inhibiting acinar cell proliferation
CCK is a major physiological regulator of pancreatic acinar cell replication; CCK receptor antagonist L-364,718 reduces S-phase entry
